sections.text:
This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I1 
for Auma Control valve type 
SAREX 10.1 F10, Com 
 No.: 604749, Ip / 67 16, 1/Min, No.: 1194MD50205, 
which 
must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated as indicated by 
Y1 in the above title block.

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Esmail Fouad, eng. Khalil Ahmad 3awad, the 
internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim Salman with EEHC MPIS, the 
document field tested at 10 Jan 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abdel 
Menem AlEmam, accepted by general director; eng. Mohamed El Sayed 
Abdel Ghafar, and approved by eng Awad Mohamed Fathy Head Sector of El-Aresh 
Power Station.

items:
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Ensure the unit out of service

Close manual isolating valves after and before 
 control valve.

Disconnect power 
 supply.

Disconnect the 
 mechanical coupling

Safety helmet, 
 shoes, and rags
Digital Ammeter, Screw Driver.
Open end Spanner set.
DC Power Supply.

Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.

Obtain copy 
 of valve field maintenance file.

Remove cover 
 and disconnect wires for and isolate the wires using tape feed back card 
 connect 24 Vdc power supply to feed back card terminal.

Connect 
 ammeter to one terminal of feed back card and the other terminal to power 
 supply.

Close valve 
 manually and record ammeter reading (check Zero feed back = 4 mA) and check 
 close limit switch

Open valve 
 manually and record ammeter reading (Check Span feed back =20 mA ) and check 
 open limit switch

Compare the 
 ammeter reading with the field maintenance file if there is any error in Zero 
 or close limit switch repeat step 1 and adjust zero and close limit switch.

Compare the 
 ammeter reading with the field maintenance file if there is any error in Span 
 or open limit switch repeat step 2 and adjust zero and open limit switch.

Repeat steps 
 3, and 4 until reach the required ammeter reading.

Return control valve to service by removing the ammeter leads 
 and power supply from the feed back card terminal.
Reconnect the wires of feed back card.
Connect power supply.
Open manual isolating valves.

Place 
 a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
